title: Titanic survival study
brief: An analytical exploration of the classic 891-passenger Titanic dataset: survival by class, sex and age as six small multiples; a class → sex → outcome survival flow diagram; per-class fare distributions on a log scale; the family-size effect; the 'women and children first' order quantified against the manifest; and three written insights — all recomputed live through interactive class and sex filters, with the full dataset embedded in the file.
da: 1912 ocean-liner museum exhibit — aged-paper sepia, slate-teal ink and oxidized-copper verdigris, art-deco ruled frames with corner diamonds, Cinzel display and numerals over Old Standard TT, engraving-style hatched fills and numbered plates.
